name: Compile WhatOnEarth IPA

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  compile:
    runs-on: macos-latest  # Instantly spins up a trusted cloud Mac runner

    steps:
      - name: 2. Transfer files to cloud Mac
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Xcode environment
        uses: maxim-lobanov/setup-xcode@v1
        with:
          xcode-version: 'latest-stable'

      # 4. Automates changing the Bundle Identifier & removes manual signing blocks
      - name: 4. Configure Signing & Bundle ID
        run: |
          sed -i '' 's/PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER = .*/PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER = com.whatonearth.custombuild;/g' WhatOnEarth.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj

      # 6. Automates "Product -> Archive" via command line without a visual desktop
      - name: 6. Product Archive & Export to IPA
        run: |
          xcodebuild archive \
            -project WhatOnEarth.xcodeproj \
            -scheme WhatOnEarth \
            -configuration Release \
            -archivePath $PWD/build/WhatOnEarth.xcarchive \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
            CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO \
            CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" \
            CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS=""

          # Packages the compiled bundle into the final .ipa file
          mkdir -p Payload
          cp -r build/WhatOnEarth.xcarchive/Products/Applications/*.app Payload/
          zip -r WhatOnEarth.ipa Payload

      - name: Upload Compiled Package
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: WhatOnEarth-Package
          path: WhatOnEarth.ipa
